title: mymind search band
description: A full-bleed tangerine band: dark spaced capitals, a big two-line ink serif headline, a white paragraph and a white play link, then a wide search line drawn as a single white hairline where query chips pop in one by one beside a blinking caret, on a loop.
notes: the band is bg-primary with ink headline and white body text: best where primary is a strong mid-tone
CSS-only loop; with reduced motion all chips show and the caret stays still
